introText: Ghost Tequila’s community is dispersed but engaged, appearing in Reddit threads, a tequila rating app, Instagram cocktail circles, and niche discussions focused on spice and cocktails.

platforms.name: Reddit (r/tequila)
platforms.description: Agave lovers occasionally discuss Ghost, noting it as a spicy tequila that still tastes good.

platforms.name: Reddit (r/HotPeppers)
platforms.description: Chili-heads share Ghost Tequila cocktail experiments and banter about the heat vs. alcohol burn.

platforms.name: Tequila Matchmaker
platforms.description: Community-driven tequila database/app where Ghost Blanco earns steady reviews and a respectable score.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.description: Home bartenders and cocktail influencers post spicy drink recipes and UGC that the brand often reshares.

quote.text: The tequila is fantastic… nice friggin’ kick to it… not a ‘hey ghost pepperz here lol’ kinda crap; it’s actually got a rip to it.
quote.author: Reddit user

closingText: Overall, Ghost sits at the intersection of tequila fans, heat-seekers, and cocktail creators—small in scale but passionate and cross-pollinated across platforms.
